queries: EcoFlow DELTA 2 Jackery Explorer 1000 v2 Anker SOLIX C1000 BLUETTI AC180 capacity official specifications
turns.answer:
To run an electric heated blanket all night (8–10 hours), I recommend a portable power station with at least 700Wh of battery capacity, ideally 1,000Wh if you want reliable overnight heating.

The key is how many watts your heated blanket consumes. Most standard electric blankets draw approximately 60–150W when actively heating, although actual consumption varies with the heat setting and thermostat cycling.

How big a power station do you need?

These are estimated minimum battery capacities, not guaranteed runtimes. Some power stations also consume additional energy keeping their AC inverter running.

My target would be a 1,000Wh LiFePO4 power station for a typical electric blanket running on a moderate setting.

One question: Is this for a regular 120V household heated blanket, or a USB/12V camping heated blanket?

That makes a big difference. A low-power USB or 12V blanket may run all night from a much smaller, cheaper power station.
